scope: Generic norns external MIDI-clock fault probe plus Mosaic opt-in application validation

oracle_mutations.summary: 5 passing tests covering complete event accounting and causal transport bounds

semantics: The probe disables clock receive on port2 and proves its transport bytes have no effect.
Steady, alternating jitter, one missing pulse, one extra pulse, tempo step and gradual drift each emit seven ordered quarter-step markers.
No-Stop clock loss freewheels at the acquired estimate; explicit Start marks the next Clock as beat zero and establishes one new phase owner.
After Stop, twelve further Clock pulses produce no output.
limitations: Loss without Start/Stop is characterized as pinned-norns holdover; its ambiguous resume policy is not certified.
Repeated/burst corruption, stochastic long jitter, simultaneous source/menu edits and broader feature interactions remain.
The optional candidate remains unpromoted; this checkpoint does not complete the manual campaign, emulator release or final hardening.
